name: tutorial step 3 Move
detail: Tutorial 3 of 7 — Move: Tap open ground to move your selected unit. A dashed line shows its path. Next tap: tap open ground to move.

name: tutorial step 4 Attack
detail: Tutorial 4 of 7 — Attack: Tap the pulsing red target to attack it. It cannot shoot back. Next tap: tap the red target.
